import pathlib,json,os,subprocess,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
records=json.loads((root/'registry.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
valid=[]
for row in records:
    p=pathlib.Path(row['Manifest'])
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    doc=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')); layer=doc.get('layer',{})
    lib=layer.get('library_path'); binary=(p.parent/lib).resolve() if lib else None
    row.update(name=layer.get('name'),manifestSha256=digest(p),binary=str(binary),binaryExists=binary.is_file() if binary else False,enableEnvironment=layer.get('enable_environment'),disableEnvironment=layer.get('disable_environment'))
    row['conditionEnvironment']={key:os.environ.get(key) for field in ('enable_environment','disable_environment') for key in layer.get(field,{})}
    if binary and binary.is_file(): row['binarySha256']=digest(binary)
    if row['Value']==0 and 'WOW6432Node' not in row['Registry'] and row.get('driverView',64)==64 and row['Registry'].endswith('ImplicitLayers'):
        valid.append((row,doc))
(root/'layer-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
implicit=root/'valid-implicit'; implicit.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for i,(row,doc) in enumerate(valid):
    doc['layer']['library_path']=row['binary']
    (implicit/f'{i}.json').write_text(json.dumps(doc))
empty=root/'empty-implicit';empty.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
explicit=root/'validation-explicit';explicit.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sdk=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('VULKAN_SDK',os.environ['VK_SDK_PATH']))
doc=json.loads((sdk/'Bin/VkLayer_khronos_validation.json').read_text())
doc['layer']['library_path']=str(sdk/'Bin/VkLayer_khronos_validation.dll')
(explicit/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(doc))
profiles={
 'ambient':{},
 'obs-disabled':{'VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE':'VK_LAYER_OBS_HOOK'},
 'epic-clean':{'VK_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH':str(implicit)},
 'canonical':{'VK_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH':str(empty),'VK_LAYER_PATH':str(explicit),'VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS':'VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation','VK_LAYER_SETTINGS_PATH':str(empty)}
}
(root/'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(profiles,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':
    results=[]
    for name,overrides in profiles.items():
        env=os.environ.copy();env.update(overrides);env['VK_LOADER_DEBUG']='error,warn,layer'
        with (root/f'loader-{name}.log').open('w') as log:
            p=subprocess.run([str(sdk/'Bin/vulkaninfoSDK.exe'),'--summary'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=60)
        results.append({'profile':name,'exit':p.returncode,'overrides':overrides})
    (root/'loader-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(results))
